name: UGC 3698 (Hubble)
blurb: UGC 3698, a nearby galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ugc3698-hubble
story: One of the nearby galaxies Hubble visited to map our cosmic neighborhood in three dimensions, using its brightest red giant stars as yardsticks for distance.

claims.text: UGC 3698 is a target of program 13442, The Geometry and Kinematics of the Local Volume
The program measures distances to nearby galaxies from tip of the red giant branch stars to build 3D maps
